verdict.rationale: dlt pipelines are plain Python code, so they can live in ordinary source control. A user notes everything can be done via code for maintainability (dlt-comm-11), there is a GitHub Actions deployment path (dlt-docs-42), and dltHub says every run is logged and auditable (dlt-docs-26). Versioning and review are only implied through external git workflows, not provided as a product feature. missing for 10: native pipeline/automation version history, a built-in review or approval workflow for changes, documented rollback to a prior pipeline version or deployment, and independent corroboration.
